## BMI and Systolic Blood Pressure in U.S. Adults

This project examines the relationship between body mass index (BMI) and systolic blood pressure among adults ages 21–79 using the 2017–March 2020 NHANES sample. I used descriptive visualizations and linear regression to examine the association between BMI and systolic blood pressure, with age and sex included in an adjusted model.
